study_identification_part.si_4_title: Brain morphology normative modelling platform for abnormality and centile estimation: Brain MoNoCle

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Generalized additive models for location, scale and shape (GAMLSS) via the gamlss package.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: Generalized additive models for location scale and shape (GAMLSS) using the gamlss package (https://cran  .  r  -  project  .  org  /  web /  packages  /  gamlss/) were used to simultaneously model the  parameters  (mean,  standard  deviation,  skew,  and kurtosis) of the distribution as response variables of the explanatory variables sex, age, and scanning site/batch.

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Cortical thickness, cortical volume, and pial surface area; additional morphology components K, I, and S (not in predefined list).
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: The aparcstats2table command was used to generate measures of cortical thickness, cortical volume, and pial surface area, for  68  brain  regions according  to  the  Desikan-  Killiany parcellation  atlas  (  Desikan    et  al.,    2006). ... We used the toolbox developed by   Wang   et al.   (2021) (https:// github  .  com  /  cnnp  -  lab  /  CorticalFoldingAnalysisT ools) to calculate K, I, and S for each hemisphere.
nm2_2_response_variable.location: Little2025.pdf.md: 2.2. Pre- processing; Little2025.pdf.md: 2.3. Cortical morphology measures

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Sex (fixed effect), scanning site/batch (random effect), and smooth age terms.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: Generalized additive models for location scale and shape (GAMLSS) using the gamlss package (https://cran  .  r  -  project  .  org  /  web /  packages  /  gamlss/) were used to simultaneously model the  parameters  (mean,  standard  deviation,  skew,  and kurtosis) of the distribution as response variables of the explanatory variables sex, age, and scanning site/batch.
